tips.q: How do you write a poster design prompt?
tips.a: Use this skeleton: '[Style] poster, [subject], [color palette], bold typography reading "[TITLE]", [supporting text], 2:3 portrait.' Always quote the headline string and specify font weight (bold / display / condensed). JSON-format prompts in this library handle the hierarchy automatically.

tips.q: Can GPT Image 2 render readable poster text?
tips.a: Yes — pixel-level text rendering is its strongest advantage over Midjourney and SDXL. Wrap titles in double quotes, keep headlines under 6 words, and pick `bold sans-serif` or `condensed display`. Multilingual scripts (JA / KO / ZH / HI) also render correctly first try.

tips.q: What should a movie poster AI prompt include?
tips.a: Five blocks: hero subject + pose, scene atmosphere, main title (quoted), tagline (quoted), and a credits billing line. Add color grade keywords like `teal-orange` or `noir monochrome` and a 2:3 portrait ratio. Our movie-poster JSON pattern wires all five into one structured prompt.

tips.q: How do I control layout and typography in AI posters?
tips.a: Switch from prose prompts to JSON-format templates: declare `header.title`, `header.title_typography: "bold sans-serif display, all caps"`, `centerpiece`, and `footer.info_text` separately. The model honors the schema, so every regeneration keeps font weight, hierarchy, and grid placement consistent.

faq.q: What's the best AI prompt for poster design?
faq.a: Reliable template: '[Style] poster, [subject] composition, [color palette], bold sans-serif typography reading "[TITLE]", [supporting text], [aspect ratio]'. Example: 'Minimalist Swiss poster, single geometric shape on cream background, red accents, bold typography reading "DESIGN MATTERS", 2:3 portrait.' GPT Image 2 renders the title text correctly first try.

faq.q: Can GPT Image 2 generate posters with readable text?
faq.a: Yes — pixel-level text rendering is its strongest feature versus Midjourney/SDXL. Wrap the exact poster title in double quotes, specify font style (sans-serif / serif / hand-lettered), and the model produces poster-ready text without Photoshop overlay.

faq.q: How do I make a vintage / retro poster with AI?
faq.a: Use this retro template: '[Decade]s-style poster, faded color palette, halftone print texture, vintage [genre] illustration, bold display font reading "[TITLE]", aged paper background, slight grain.' Specify the decade (1950s diner / 1970s disco / 1980s sci-fi) for accuracy.

faq.q: What size and aspect ratio for AI-generated posters?
faq.a: Use 2:3 portrait (24×36 inches print standard) or 1:1 square for social. Always generate at 2K resolution (10 credits) for print quality. For Instagram-only sharing, 1K is enough (6 credits).

faq.q: Is there a ChatGPT prompt for poster design that works?
faq.a: ChatGPT image generation IS GPT Image 2 under the hood. Our Studio uses the same model with cleaner prompt parsing and no rate limits. All ChatGPT poster prompts work here, plus we have 14 tested templates organized by style.

template.subject: {argument name="subject" default="abstract geometric form"}
template.color_palette: {argument name="palette" default="red and black on cream"}

header.title: {argument name="title" default="DESIGN MATTERS"}
header.title_typography: {argument name="title_font" default="bold sans-serif display, all caps"}
header.subtitle: {argument name="subtitle" default=""}

centerpiece.composition: centered with generous negative space, balanced asymmetry

template.texture_overlay: {argument name="texture" default="subtle paper grain, aged feel"}
